response:
I am so sorry you are going through this. Hearing that your wife wants a divorce so suddenly, especially without an explanation, must be incredibly shocking and painful. It is completely natural to feel confused and to want to fight to keep your family together. 

Deciding whether to try and save your marriage is a deeply personal choice. A good first step might be to gently express your commitment to your family and ask if she would be open to couples counseling. A neutral environment might help her feel comfortable enough to finally share her reasons. However, remember that you can only control your own actions and cannot force her to open up. Focus on being a steady, supportive presence for your daughter right now. You might also find it very helpful to speak with an individual counselor to help you process this sudden shock, manage your grief, and navigate the difficult decisions ahead.
